description: This file contains React hooks and utility functions for fetching and processing dataset information in the Superset frontend, including dataset ID extraction, verbose map creation, and a hook for retrieving dataset drill info with extension support.

methods.name: getDatasetId
methods.description: Extracts a numeric dataset ID from a string or number, handling strings with '__' separator.

methods.name: createVerboseMap
methods.description: Creates a verbose mapping for dataset columns and metrics, defaulting to their names if verbose names are not provided.

methods.name: useDatasetDrillInfo
methods.description: React hook to fetch dataset drill information, supporting extension-based and standard API retrieval, with verbose map integration.
